retail_vs_institutional_reaction.retail_sentiment_summary: Retail investors on Reddit and Stocktwits are expressing frustration over the headline revenue miss ($17.16B vs $17.55B consensus) and the -4.6% after-hours pullback after IBM stock recently traded at all-time highs above $250. Bullish commenters highlight the dividend safety and watsonx GenAI book crossing $3.0B, while bears point to Consulting stagnation as a sign of economic caution.
retail_vs_institutional_reaction.institutional_sentiment_summary: Institutional portfolio managers view the print as a classic high-multiple re-rating event. Having rallied ~40% year-to-date, IBM faced an elevated bar. While Software and Red Hat performed adequately (+14% growth), the Consulting segment's 0.2% growth validated concerns seen across peers that enterprise discretionary IT budgets remain frozen. However, raising the full-year FCF guide to >$13.0B provides an institutional valuation floor.
retail_vs_institutional_reaction.after_hours_movement_driver: The stock declined -4.64% to $239.80 (down -$11.66 from $251.46 regular close) primarily due to the Consulting revenue shortfall ($5.33B vs $5.48B expected) and headline revenue miss, though the drop was contained within the ±7.11% options-implied straddle band.
